verdict.rationale: Marketing copy mentions a natural-language audience-building feature ('Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal... mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use') which implies limited AI-assisted task delegation, but this is scoped only to audience creation, not a general-purpose built-in AI assistant for broader tasks. Missing for 10: documentation of assistant capabilities beyond audience suggestions, evidence of task execution/delegation across the platform, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this feature works as described.
